notes.title: How to play? - Mini Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/8591f200360306b0a5c136f6edd2b5c82d9db61b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/b06722147f9c3ef662d027dabf5246f9a5cf7922.png[/img]
[b]1. 1 ~ 3 Select the stage.[/b]
- Each stage has a different difficulty level.
- Final winner of each stage is recorded

[b]2. choose a weapon.[/b]
- Play 'Repair' and 'Challenge' to obtain the 'Get Weapon' achievement.

[b]3. Attack power increases when you clear 'Repair' and 'Challenge'[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/85c5982fb2d79a52f1d11991a1c57e07b823156e.png[/img]
Keyboard and mouse

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/5002d1b298abb4a1e084c1b1e6045bcd1845c6bc.png[/img]
Gamepad

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/1139e1808c51a23e4a7686d70ef70c214044b922.png[/img]
[b]Hp[/b] - add stamina by 2
[b]Hint[/b] - add hint (99 limit)
[b]Time[/b] - add time by 5 seconds
